evidenceBasis: campaign result metrics, mechanically derived by the engine from the run's own action log (nightwatch.campaign-yield.v1); the admission passed the existing mechanical reproduction/dossier gate unchanged

harnessDefect.description: the run-harness revision in use for generation-2 runs 04-05 recorded only the admission count and did not persist the mechanical dossier to owner-local state; the campaign deletes its owner-local checkpoint on NO_PROGRESS, so the dossier content and target identity are not recoverable for run 05
harnessDefect.repair: run-matrix.mjs now writes each admission dossier to $HOME/.nightwatch/w13-runs/<runId>/dossiers/<candidateId>.json (owner-local, never committed) and records its identity in the run receipt
harnessDefect.repairCommit: pending commit in the same session

novelty.reason: the mechanical admission exists, but its dossier identity was not preserved by the harness revision in use, so no comparison against the frozen known-defect corpus is claimed
